title: Seagrove Serenity - 30A Five Star Properties
description_expanded:
🌊 SEAGROVE SERENITY — Why Guests Love Staying Here

⭐ Professionally managed with 24/7 guest support by 30A Five Star Properties for a smooth, worry-free vacation 🏖️ Beachfront complex right on the Gulf of Mexico — just minutes from your door to toes in the sand ⛱️ Seasonal beach chair service included (2 chairs + umbrella | March 1–Oct 31) 🔒 Private beach access exclusively for guests & owners in this low-density community (only 24 units total) 👨‍👩‍👧 Sleeps up to 6 guests with a queen bed, hallway bunk beds & sofa sleeper — perfect for families 👶 Pack ’n Play provided (please bring your own sheets) ⛱️ Beach chairs included for easy, relaxing beach days 📍 Centrally located in Seagrove Beach — walk to restaurants, shops & attractions, and only 1.3 miles to Seaside 🏊 Community pool & grill area for relaxing and cooking after a beach day 🧺 Washer & dryer inside the unit for added convenience during your stay 🍳 Fully stocked kitchen with coffee maker for easy meals & mornings in 📺 Smart TVs in both living room & bedroom for streaming your favorite shows ⚡ High-speed wireless internet to keep everyone connected 🚲 Direct access to the bike path along Scenic Highway 30A — explore 19 miles of scenic coastal communities

Relax and unwind in this cozy Seagrove condo. Private and direct beach access, this one-bedroom getaway comes fully equipped with all the comforts of home. The full kitchen comes ready for home cooking with a full suite of major appliances, including a dishwasher for easy cleanup. The private balcony is perfect for sipping a morning cup of coffee or a sunset cocktail. The spacious primary bedroom includes a smart TV for added entertainment options. A built-in hallway bunk nook is great for kids to have their own space.

WHAT'S NEARBY This property is part of the Beachside Condos, a Gulf-front complex in Seagrove with a private boardwalk that leads to the beach. You'll be across the street from several shops, eateries, and recreational outfitters that rent bikes and kayaks.

THINGS TO KNOW

Parking notes: 1 spot per unit. No assigned spot, can park in any spot.

Golf cart rentals are allowed. You can rent a gas powered golf cart and utilize your 1 parking space OR rent a battery powered golf cart rental across the street at Butterfly Bike and Kayak and park/charge there.

This rental is located on the ground floor.

Sorry, HOA does not allow pets.

WE OFFER A STARTER SUPPLY OF PREMIUM GUEST AMENITIES Body Wash | Shampoo | Conditioner | Hand Soap | Toilet Paper | Dish Soap | Dishwasher Pods | Laundry Detergent | Paper Towels | Trash Bags | Dish Sponge | Bath towels | Bed linens

Check-In: A keypad is available 24 hours a day to provide entry for guests
